specs.Metrics Measured: Heart Rate Monitor, Menstrual Cycle, Sleep Duration, Step Count, Stress
specs.Target Audience: Men, Unisex Adults, Unisex Youth, Women

features: SCREEN-FREE BY DESIGN — No display, no distractions. The Alti FIT+ works quietly in the background while the app does the talking, so you stay focused on your day, not your wrist.
A FULLER PICTURE OF YOUR WELLNESS — HRV, SpO2, heart rate, sleep and stress levels, all in one place, so you understand your body's patterns instead of guessing at them.
SLEEP, DECODED — Tracks your light, deep, and REM cycles alongside wake-ups through the night, then turns it into a simple sleep score so you know exactly where your rest is falling short.
EVERY STEP COUNTS — Continuous tracking of steps, calories, and distance keeps your activity story running in the background, all day, every day. 20+ Sports Mode for sports tracking.
JUST SAY WHAT YOU ATE — Log meals by voice in the app instead of scrolling through food databases, making nutrition tracking as quick as talking to a friend.
45+ DAYS ON A SINGLE CHARGE — Built for people who don't want to think about charging cables. Wear it, forget it, and let it keep tracking.
YOUR DATA, IN YOUR POCKET — Pairs with the Alti app to turn raw numbers into daily insights and long-term trends you can actually act on.
